operation.summary: Your own records on the phone, in key order with their values, about 48 KB a page (pass next as after for the next page)

query.name: prefix
query.description: Only keys that start with this (e.g. item.)

query.name: after
query.description: Start after this key (the last page's next)

operation.returns: records [{key, value, updated_at, chars}], next (null at the end), count, total_chars, max_records, max_total_chars

prefix.description: Only keys that start with this (e.g. item.)

after.description: Start after this key (the last page's next)
